palette.notes: Each room owns one hue: plum-purple hallways, blood-red mansion, teal-and-cream club, navy city at night. Shadows sink to near-black violet; warm accents (fireplace orange, lamp yellow, red lanterns) are the only hot spots. No metrics file.

lighting: Motivated pools of light: a fireplace or wall lamp throws an orange cone into a red room, a window throws pale light shafts onto a grey floor, neon signs glow over a bar. The rest of the room falls off to dark, so the tiny hero reads where the light is.
silhouette: Hero is tiny (about 1/10 of frame height) with dark hair and coat; he reads by the bright rainbow slash smear, which is longer than his body, and by standing in a lit patch. The giant room is the star; the sprite is a dark notch in it.

motion.timing: Fast actions (a slash smear spanning half a corridor in one frame) against long static holds in quiet rooms: the hero sits at a desk and only the TV and a coloured pickup label change over 3 s of the sheet. No frame timings measured.

texture: Clean pixels with dense set dressing (posters, bottles, stair rails, brick); a chromatic RGB-split trail on the slash; VHS glitch and rewind treatment noted by critics.
camera: Locked side-on shot of one room at a time, the room filling the frame like a diorama; scene changes are hard cuts between rooms. Screen shake and distortion punctuate hits and dialogue (wiki).

acting.enters: He is already in the room or walks in from a door at one side, tiny, with no fanfare; the title card drops over him in the hallway.
acting.acts: Quiet beats are staged as life in a lived-in room: sitting at a desk, by a fire, at a bar. Action beats are one bright slash. Story is shown through play, not told (wiki).
acting.exits: Leaves through a doorway or the frame edge; failed attempts end in a tape-rewind to the room's start (wiki).
acting.depth: Flat side-on rooms; depth from layered light, a lower floor seen below a walkway, and a whole city skyline with the hero as a speck in the foreground.

techniques: one dominant hue per room, warm practical light as the only hot spot
light cone from a lamp or fireplace to place the small hero
rainbow RGB-split smear longer than the body on the slash
tiny hero in a huge detailed room: the set tells the story
long static hold with one small change (TV flicker, label pop)
VHS rewind/glitch as a reset transition
feel: one-hue room + warm lamp pool + tiny dark hero + one rainbow slash smear = moody, slick, punchy
for_fred: Give each Fred scene one dominant hue with a single warm light patch, and stand Fred in it, small; let the room carry the mood. When he does the gag, make it one fast smear frame, then a long still hold with only one small thing changing. Use a tape-rewind once per reel for his 'try again'.
